title: Psalms 1
paragraphs: ¹ Blessed is the one who doesn't follow the advice of the wicked, or take the path of sinners, or sit in the company of mockers. ² Instead, they delight in the law of the LORD and meditate on it day and night. ³ They are like a tree planted beside streams of water — bearing fruit in season, never losing its leaves, prospering in everything they do. ⁴ The wicked are nothing like this — they are like chaff blown away by the wind. ⁵ So the wicked won't stand when judgment comes, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
⁶ For the LORD watches over the path of the righteous, but the path of the wicked leads to ruin.
